constraints.ocl:
context User
inv: (self.posts->exists(x | x.isPublic = false)) and (self.posts->notEmpty())

context Membership
inv: (self.user <> null) and (self.role <> null)

context Message
inv: (self.sender <> null) and (self.body <> null)

context Comment
inv: (self.post.isPublic) and (self.text <> '' and self.text.size() > 0)

context Conversation
inv: (self.messages->any(x | x.isRead = true) <> null) and (self.participants->size() = 1)

context User
inv: (self.notifications->any(x | x.isSeen = false) <> null) and (self.notifications->notEmpty())

context Tag
inv: self.posts->any(x | x.isPublic <> false) <> null

context Post
inv: (self.isPublic = false) and (self.comments->forAll(v | v.createdAt <> ''))

context Post
inv: (self.isPublic <> true) and (self.reactions->forAll(v | v.createdAt <> ''))

context Tag
inv: ((self.posts->isEmpty()) and (self.posts->size() >= 2)) and (not((self.posts->isEmpty()) and (self.posts->size() >= 2)))

context User
inv: (self.posts->collect(x | x.comments)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.posts->collect(x | x.comments)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context Profile
inv: ((self.user <> null) and (self.bio.size() <= 65)) and (not((self.user <> null) and (self.bio.size() <= 65)))

context Group
inv: (self.memberships->exists(x | x.role <> '')) and (not(self.memberships->exists(x | x.role <> '')))

context Membership
inv: ((self.group <> null) and (self.user <> null)) and (not((self.group <> null) and (self.user <> null)))

context Reaction
inv: ((self.post.isPublic) and (self.type <> null)) and (not((self.post.isPublic) and (self.type <> null)))

context FriendRequest
inv: ((self.createdAt <> null) and (self.isAccepted = true)) and (not((self.createdAt <> null) and (self.isAccepted = true)))

context Conversation
inv: (self.participants->any(x | x.createdAt <> '') <> null) and (not(self.participants->any(x | x.createdAt <> '') <> null))
